selected_evidence.requirement: LDAP directory imported without changing supplied identities or mail addresses
selected_evidence.summary: The staged LDIF and final directory both show alex/Alex North/alex@branch.test and sam/Sam West/sam@branch.test, with two total users.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 can search the people subtree and find both users
selected_evidence.summary: Remote searches from node2 returned both complete user records before and after restarts.

selected_evidence.requirement: Updates require an authenticated administrator and anonymous writes fail
selected_evidence.summary: Anonymous modifications failed with authentication-required before and after restart; authenticated administrator modifications succeeded and test attributes were removed.

selected_evidence.requirement: Operating-system release and kernel preserved with legacy-compatible software
selected_evidence.summary: Both nodes remained Ubuntu 16.04 with kernel 4.4.0-210-generic; OpenLDAP 2.4.42 packages from Xenial were used.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart and LDAP recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID a9593011…, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 04a178c8…, and recovered slapd listener plus both records.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 mandatory restart and client recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID 35c87ec9…, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 67f39d73…, and recovered LDAP client access to both remote records.

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo install -d -m 700 /root/.ldap-secrets
if [ ! -s /root/.ldap-secrets/admin-password ]; then
  openssl rand -base64 36 | sudo tee /root/.ldap-secrets/admin-password >/dev/null
  sudo chmod 600 /root/.ldap-secrets/admin-password
fi
LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]]] sed -n '1p' /root/.ldap-secrets/admin-password)
printf '%s\n' \
  "slapd slapd/no_configuration boolean false" \
  "slapd slapd/domain string branch.test" \
  "slapd shared/organization string Branch Test" \
  "slapd slapd/password1 password $LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD" \
  "slapd slapd/password2 password $LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD" \
  "slapd slapd/backend select MDB" \
  "slapd slapd/purge_database boolean true" \
  "slapd slapd/move_old_database boolean true" \
  "slapd slapd/allow_ldap_v2 boolean false" | sudo debconf-set-selections
sudo env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y slapd ldap-utils
unset LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD
systemctl is-active slapd
sudo slapcat -n 0 | sed -n '1,60p'
printf 'SECRET_FILE_MODE=[REDACTED]]]%a %U:%G' /root/.ldap-secrets/admin-password
